title: THE OLD MESSAGE PLACES ARE GONE
why: His order of 2026-10-14: one feed and one alert lane, nothing else. Everything the old places showed is a line in the feed now, so they are not drawn any more: the message rows at the top centre, the pickup stack and the co-op kill feed at the right edge, the rising item names and other message labels at the world, and the medal plates over the cursor (the combo ring stays). The right edge is free for the gun card and the panels. Hit feedback stays on its target: WEAK SPOT, ACTIVE RELOAD, CLOSE CALL and PICKED UP. Interaction prompts, enemy marks, the boss bar, the gun card and the end of raid cards are not touched.
now: The old message rows, pickup stack, kill feed, loot labels and medal plates are gone; the feed and the alert lane carry everything.
